title: 第14章 雷云豹第15章 激战
content_zh:
“咕噜！”
于是，很快肉干和水就送到了肖恩的手中，而肖恩，也是争分夺秒的狼吞虎咽。
这种干巴巴的肉干，当然及不上肖恩自己的烤肉，不过，这也许是肖恩出生以来吃到的最香的一顿饭。
哪怕是在天绝谷里，肖恩也是没有尝试过会饿肚子的，何况是这次一饿就是好几天，现在只要是能够丢进口中的东西，他都能吃出人间最美的味道来。
不过，此刻整个车队的人都是沉浸在绝望的恐慌之中，也没有人去注意到肖恩那难看的吃相。
“呼！”
而随着那干瘪的腹中渐渐的变得充实，肖恩的精气神也是恢复了不少，他的眼神深处，掠过一抹极为锋利的锐利。
那曾经追赶着他到处奔逃的力量，如今似乎用不着再忌惮了。
“吼！”
天地之间，似乎是有着暴戾的吼声陡然的响起，只见得前方的大地震动，惊人的凶威滚滚而上，然后以一种惊人的速度席卷而来。
最后一道体型庞大的凶兽，极为震撼的出现在了所有人的视线之内。
那是一头足足有十数丈之大的豹形魔兽，浑身布满了如同金钱一般的银色斑纹，斑纹之上，隐有雷光闪烁。
可怕的气势，在此时铺天盖地的席卷而出，整个天地都是在此时颤抖起来。
“三……三级魔兽雷云豹！”
一道道带着震颤的声音，也是随着这头雷光闪烁的凶兽出现而响起，整个车队内的每一个人都是面色苍白，那种绝望，几乎是彻底的让他们失去了反抗之心。
先前的兽潮虽然庞大，最少，他们还有一拼之力，但在这个存在的面前，恐怕他们连抗衡的资格都没有。
三级魔兽，也就等同于人类修者的第三个境界炼元境。
这个天地的修炼之人，每一个境界都是存在着一道层次分明的天堑，并被视为无法逾越的鸿沟。
淬元境，纯属淬炼肉身，单纯的身体力量。
而聚元境，则是在体内产生元气，使得肉身力量升华成为一种战斗形态的气流。

不过，这两个境界的力量，都是束缚在体内，唯有达到炼元境，才能够将元气凝炼成真正的战斗形态，也就是拟形。
在某种意义上说，炼元境，才是修炼之人真正的开始。
由此可见，这三级魔兽雷云豹的出现，所带给整个车队的绝望是何等之大。
毕竟，他们当中，境界最高，实力最强的乔横，也不过是聚元境大圆满，自问在这雷云豹面前，依然是脆弱得不堪一击。
“咕咚！”
而事实上，望着面前的雷云豹，乔横握刀的手掌也是微微的震颤着，喉咙吞咽唾沫的闷响，充分的显示了他心内的紧张和忌惮。
不过，整个车队，也就他实力最强，也唯有硬着头皮上前迎战。
“这一次，真的麻烦了！”
而望着并没有离开的肖恩，福伯也是无奈的摇了摇头，错过了离开的良机，现在已经在雷云豹的眼皮底下，恐怕再也没有这个机会了。
笼罩在三级魔兽雷云豹凶焰下的百草堂武师，情不自禁的握紧了手上的武器，只是眼神深处，那种绝望和恐惧，却是掩饰不住。
肖恩很讨厌车队这种消极的气息，他认为，无论是遭遇到多大的强敌，都必须要拿出殊死一拼的勇气和决心。
否则，修炼之路，时刻都会有出现在自己面前的一座座大山，每每遇上强敌，首先感到的是恐惧，还不如直截了当的自杀算了，省得去反复承受那份死亡恐惧的折磨。
在试炼山脉中经历无数次的生死，就连是自己有时为了提升一点点的实力，都会拿命去拼，就眼前这种情况，在他的眼里，离危险二字还远得很。
“孩子，快来到我的身边。”
慈祥的声音传到了肖恩的耳里，尽管已经失去了活着的希望，福伯还是想尽自己最大的可能去保护肖恩。
这令到肖恩有种被关怀着的感觉，不知不觉中，还是成为了被保护的对象。
毕竟，在所有人当中，肖恩不但是年纪最小，还是境界最低的一个，而福伯颇有长者风范，就算是死，也希望自己挡在肖恩前面。
“吼！”
而这种等待，并没有持续多久，那雷云豹便是再度发出了惊天动地的吼声，一股可怕的残暴之气自其体内散发出来。
“照顾好福伯。”

肖恩站了起来，对着身边的雅儿小姐说道。
这雷云豹只要一发动攻击，肖恩知道，这不是乔横能够承受得了的。
“孩子，不要去，危险。”心地善良的福伯怎么忍心让一个十六岁的孩子出去面对这凶残的雷云豹，连忙的对着肖恩大喊道。
雅儿小姐更加的是一脸惊愕，急着出声喊道：“喂，傻小子，快回来，你想干什么？”
content_en:
"Gulu!"
So, the dried meat and water were soon delivered to Sean's hands, and Sean was also racing against time to wolf down the food.
This kind of dry jerky is certainly not as good as Sean's own barbecue, but it may be the most delicious meal Sean has eaten since he was born.
Even in Tianjue Valley, Sean has never been hungry before, let alone this time he has been hungry for several days. Now, as long as he can put things in his mouth, he can taste the most delicious food in the world.
However, at this moment, the entire team was immersed in desperate panic, and no one noticed Sean's ugly eating look.
"Phew!"
And as the withered belly gradually became fuller, Sean's energy and energy also recovered a lot, and there was an extremely sharp look in the depths of his eyes.
The power that once chased him everywhere seemed to no longer need to be feared.
"Roar!"
Between heaven and earth, there seemed to be a violent roar that suddenly sounded. The ground in front was shaken, and an astonishing force rolled up, and then swept over at an astonishing speed.
The last huge beast appeared in everyone's sight in a shocking manner.
It was a leopard-shaped monster that was more than ten feet in size. Its whole body was covered with silver stripes that looked like money. On the stripes, there were hidden flashes of lightning.
The terrifying momentum swept out overwhelmingly at this moment, and the whole world trembled at this moment.
"Third...Level 3 Magical Beast Thunder Cloud Leopard!"
A series of trembling sounds also sounded with the appearance of this fierce beast with flashing lightning. Everyone in the entire convoy turned pale. The despair almost completely made them lose their will to resist.
Although the previous beast tide was huge, at least they still had the strength to fight, but in front of this existence, I am afraid they are not even qualified to compete.
The third-level magic beast is equivalent to the third realm of human cultivators, the Refining Realm.
For cultivators in this world, every realm has a clear-cut chasm, which is regarded as an insurmountable gap.
The Yuan Yuan Realm is purely about tempering the physical body and pure physical strength.
The Juyuan realm generates vitality in the body, sublimating the physical power into a fighting form of airflow.
However, the power of these two realms is bound within the body. Only by reaching the Yuan Refining Realm can the energy be condensed into a true fighting form, which is a form.
In a sense, the Refining Realm is the true beginning of a cultivator.
It can be seen from this that the appearance of this third-level magic beast Thunder Cloud Leopard has brought great despair to the entire convoy.
After all, among them, Qiao Heng, who has the highest level and the strongest strength, is only at the Great Perfection of Juyuan Realm. He thinks that he is still vulnerable in front of this Thunder Cloud Leopard.
"Gudong!"
In fact, looking at the Thunder Cloud Leopard in front of him, Qiao Heng's palm holding the knife was trembling slightly, and the muffled sound of swallowing saliva fully showed the tension and fear in his heart.
However, he was the strongest in the entire team, so he had no choice but to step forward to fight.
"This time, it's really troublesome!"
Looking at Sean who had not left, Fu Bo also shook his head helplessly. He missed the good opportunity to leave. Now that he was under the eyes of Lei Yunbao, he might never have this opportunity again.
The Baicaotang martial artist, shrouded in the ferocious flames of the third-level monster Thunder Cloud Leopard, could not help but tighten the weapon in his hand, but he could not hide the despair and fear deep in his eyes.
Sean hates the negative atmosphere of the team. He believes that no matter how powerful an enemy you encounter, you must have the courage and determination to fight to the death.
Otherwise, on the road of cultivation, there will be mountains appearing in front of you all the time. Whenever you encounter a strong enemy, the first thing you feel is fear. It is better to be straightforward.Just kill him, so you don't have to endure the torture of the fear of death over and over again.
Having experienced countless lives and deaths in the Trial Mountains, he would sometimes risk his life just to improve his strength a little bit. In his eyes, this situation was far from dangerous.
"Child, come to me quickly."
The kind voice reached Sean's ears. Although he had lost hope of living, Fubo still wanted to do his best to protect Sean.
This made Sean feel cared for, and unknowingly, he became the object of protection.
After all, among all the people, Sean is not only the youngest, but also the one with the lowest level, and Fu Bo has the demeanor of an elder. Even if he dies, he hopes to stand in front of Sean.
"Roar!"
And this kind of waiting did not last long. The Thundercloud Leopard once again let out an earth-shattering roar, and a terrifying aura of cruelty emitted from its body.
"Take care of Uncle Fu."
Sean stood up and said to Miss Yaer beside him.
As soon as the Thundercloud Leopard launched an attack, Sean knew that this was not something Qiao Heng could bear.
"Child, don't go, it's dangerous." The kind-hearted Fu Bo couldn't bear to let a sixteen-year-old child go out to face this ferocious thunder cloud leopard, so he quickly shouted to Sean.
Miss Ya'er looked even more shocked and shouted anxiously: "Hey, silly boy, come back quickly, what do you want to do?"
